bug_semantics: CWE-620 unverified password change (with CWE-862 as a later access-preserving skip): any authenticated WeGIA user can set a new password for their own account without the current password. At 3.9.1, FuncionarioControle::alterarSenha() hashed nova_senha and, if POST redir was present, called verificarSenhaConfig() instead of verificarSenha(). verificarSenhaConfig() only compared nova_senha to confirmar_senha and returned success code 3; alterarSenha() then persisted the hash via FuncionarioDAO::alterarSenha(). Attacker-controlled redir (advisory PoC uses redir=alterar_senha.php; the 3.9.1 self-service form already posts redir=logout.php) therefore skips senha_antiga. Cross-user changes are blocked by verificaAdm(). After 9aff841a, controle/control.php also skips middleware permission checks when metodo==alterarSenha, so any logged-in role can invoke the method. CVE-2026-76633 is PUBLISHED (not withdrawn/rejected); first-party GHSA-gfcx-7973-hjmp is published with withdrawn_at=null; affected <3.9.2, patched 3.9.2.
flaw_origin: BIC 15e731ab88c486ed233f0b5107b5b98c23a3e1c6 (2020-07-03, author/committer root <matheus.cefetnf@gmail.com>) first wrote verificarSenhaConfig() and replaced alterarSenha()'s unconditional verificarSenha() call with if(isset($redir)) { verificarSenhaConfig(); } so the new admin html/configurar_senhas.php flow could set a password without the old one. Immediate parent de762fa51ec6c6a2f8cc5cdebbb51086b618bf03 always required verificarSenha() (old-password check) and has no verificarSenhaConfig/isset($redir) anywhere in the tree. That attacker-controlled redir predicate is the first write of the unverified-change mechanism. Later restyles (253308d26 URL-redirection rewrite, f3a734820 deepseek-coder-v2 indent/htmlspecialchars restyle, 6e06421e0 brace style) and the 3.8.0 web/ directory move preserved the same branch and are not BICs. The 2024 control.php alterarSenha exemption (9aff841a) is a later contributing skip that kept the already-vulnerable method callable after permission checks were added; 3.9.2 left that skip in place and fixed the redir path instead.
